sentences.en: Changing how people perceive and receive mental health services is not an easy task.
sentences.zh: 改变人们对心理健康服务的看法和接受方式并非易事。

sentences.en: The stigma associated with mental illness remains a difficult barrier for many.
sentences.zh: 与精神疾病相关的污名对许多人来说仍然是一个难以逾越的障碍。

sentences.en: But we speak with a psychologist who is making mental health services, trainings, and screenings more accessible to people in one city.
sentences.zh: 但我们采访了一位心理学家，他正在让某座城市的居民更容易获得心理健康服务、培训和筛查。

sentences.en: He hopes other cities and towns will follow his lead.
sentences.zh: 他希望其他城市和城镇也能效仿他的做法。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学话语》栏目。

sentences.en: Arthur Evans is the Commissioner of Philadelphia's Department of Behavioral Health and Intellectual Disability Services.
sentences.zh: 亚瑟·埃文斯是费城行为健康与智力残疾服务局的局长。

sentences.en: A clinical and community psychologist, Dr. Evans focuses his work on improving treatment options for people suffering from addiction and other mental illnesses.
sentences.zh: 作为一名临床和社区心理学家，埃文斯博士致力于改善成瘾和其他精神疾病患者的治疗选择。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Evans.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，埃文斯博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: One of your major initiatives with the City of Philadelphia is to change how people perceive and receive community mental health services.
sentences.zh: 您在费城推出的主要举措之一，就是改变人们对社区心理健康服务的看法与接受方式。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about some of the ways you're doing that?
sentences.zh: 您能给我们讲讲您是通过哪些方式来做到这一点的吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I think it's one of the most important things that we can do right now as a field.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们作为这一领域目前能做的最重要的事情之一。

sentences.en: The country is really dealing with the issue of mental health.
sentences.zh: 全国上下确实都在应对心理健康这个问题。

sentences.en: How do people access services?
sentences.zh: 人们如何获得服务？

sentences.en: How do people get what they need?
sentences.zh: 人们如何得到他们需要的东西？

sentences.en: One of the things that we realize and recognize is that people have very strong views about mental illness.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到并认识到的一点是，人们对精神疾病有着非常强烈的看法。

sentences.en: There is stigma around that.
sentences.zh: 这周围存在着一种污名化。

sentences.en: And we feel strongly that if we're really going to help people, we not only need to make sure that the services are there,
sentences.zh: 我们坚信，如果我们真的想帮助人们，我们不仅需要确保服务到位，

sentences.en: but people are actually going to reach out for those services.
sentences.zh: 还要确保人们真正愿意去寻求这些服务。

sentences.en: So we're using a variety of methods to do that.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们正在采用各种方法来实现这一点。

sentences.en: Can you give us an example of how you're doing that?
sentences.zh: 您能举个例子说明你们是怎么做的吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So one of them that we recently just did implement, it was to implement a mental health screening kiosk in a retail pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 我们最近刚落实的一个举措，就是在零售药店里设置心理健康筛查亭。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思呢？

sentences.en: That means that next to the blood pressure cuff at your local pharmacy, you will be able to take a mental health screening.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在当地药店的血压计旁边，你将能够进行心理健康筛查。

sentences.en: And it takes about five minutes at the moSt.
sentences.zh: 这最多只需要大约五分钟。

sentences.en: It gives you information and feedback on whether or not you are likely to have a mental health condition.
sentences.zh: 它会向你提供信息和反馈，告诉你是否可能存在心理健康状况。

sentences.en: It's not to diagnose.
sentences.zh: 这不是为了下诊断。

sentences.en: It's not to give you a diagnosis or that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 不是为了给你一个诊断结果或类似的事情。

sentences.en: But it's to say, you know, your symptoms, what you're reporting to us is consistent with depression or anxiety disorder or PTSD.
sentences.zh: 而是告诉你，你知道的，你的症状、你向我们反映的情况符合抑郁症、焦虑症或创伤后应激障碍的特征。

sentences.en: And here are some resources that you can reach out to for help.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些你可以寻求帮助的资源。

sentences.en: So next to, for example, the blood pressure cuff that you're seeing too, it's not going to tell you whether or not you have heart disease.
sentences.zh: 所以就像你看到的血压计旁边一样，它不会告诉你你是否有心脏病。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it may give you indication that it could be going that way.
sentences.zh: 但它可能会给你一个迹象，表明可能会朝那个方向发展。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And like a blood pressure cuff, the idea is, again, not to diagnose yourself, but to find out whether or not you should seek help from your physician.
sentences.zh: 就像血压计一样，其理念同样不是自我诊断，而是找出你是否应该向你的医生寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And in this way, what people are doing is finding out if they should seek help from a mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，人们正在弄清楚自己是否应该向心理健康专业人士寻求帮助。

sentences.en: So we're very excited.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常兴奋。

sentences.en: It's the first time it's been done in the country.
sentences.zh: 这是全国头一次这样做。

sentences.en: Our goal is to work with pharmacies around the city to get them to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是与全市的药店合作，让他们也来做这件事。

sentences.en: And we think we're going to be successful with that.
sentences.zh: 我们认为我们在这方面会取得成功。

sentences.en: Now, this is surprising even to me.
sentences.zh: 这甚至让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: According to the National Alliance on Mental Illness, more than 57 million people will be diagnosed with a mental health disorder this year.
sentences.zh: 根据全美精神疾病联盟的数据，今年将有超过5700万人被诊断出患有心理健康障碍。

sentences.en: That's a large number, and too many of them will not seek mental health services.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的数字，其中有太多人不会去寻求心理健康服务。

sentences.en: How can psychologists within communities help to reduce the stigma associated with treatment, especially treatment for addiction, for example?
sentences.zh: 社区内的心理学家如何帮助减少与治疗相关的污名，尤其是例如成瘾治疗的污名？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I think one of the most important things is that we demystify what we do.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得最重要的事情之一，就是揭开我们工作的神秘面纱。

sentences.en: I think it's essential.
sentences.zh: 我认为这至关重要。

sentences.en: I often talk about our field working on a black box principle, meaning that we have treatment programs or private practice offices.
sentences.zh: 我经常谈到我们这一领域按黑箱原则运作，这意味着我们有治疗项目或私人诊所办公室。

sentences.en: They are sort of a mystery to the community.
sentences.zh: 对社区来说，它们有点像个谜。

sentences.en: People see those programs, and one of the things we're doing in Philadelphia to try to address that is we, as a payer of those services, say to our providers,
sentences.zh: 人们看到了这些项目，我们在费城试图解决这个问题所做的事情之一就是，作为这些服务的资助方，我们对服务提供者说，

sentences.en: you really have to be a part of the community, not just in the community.
sentences.zh: 你们真的必须成为社区的一部分，而不仅仅是身处社区之中。

sentences.en: And what that means is we expect that people are going to do outreach, that they're going to do community screenings, that they're going to do education,
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们期望人们开展外展服务，开展社区筛查，进行教育，

sentences.en: that they're going to invite people in for various kinds of events.
sentences.zh: 邀请人们参加各种活动。

sentences.en: And the providers who do that have, I think, recognized that by doing that, they are perceived much differently.
sentences.zh: 而这样做的服务提供者，我认为他们已经认识到，通过这样做，人们对他们的看法大不相同了。

sentences.en: People are much more willing to reach out to them when they need help.
sentences.zh: 当人们需要帮助时，他们会更愿意向这些人求助。

sentences.en: And I think as a general rule, that's something that we need to do as a profession, is to get out of what, again, I call our black boxes, our treatment programs, our offices,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为作为一个一般规律，这是我们作为一个职业需要做的事情，那就是走出我再次称之为黑箱的东西，即我们的治疗项目、我们的办公室，

sentences.en: get into communities, let people see us in a different kind of role.
sentences.zh: 走进社区，让人们在不同的角色中看到我们。

sentences.en: And I think it goes a long way in helping to reduce the stigma.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于帮助减少污名大有帮助。

sentences.en: Do you think the Affordable Care Act, which was implemented by the Obama administration,
sentences.zh: 您认为由奥巴马政府推行的《平价医疗法案》，

sentences.en: is it doing its part in making more mental health services available to people who need them?
sentences.zh: 在为需要心理健康服务的人提供更多服务方面，它是否在发挥作用？

sentences.en: Have you noticed this?
sentences.zh: 您注意到了这一点吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然。

sentences.en: Because if you look at the number of people who have a diagnosable mental disorder, you look at the number of people who do not seek treatment,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你看看那些有可诊断精神障碍的人数，再看看那些不寻求治疗的人数，

sentences.en: one of the big reasons is that people don't have health insurance.
sentences.zh: 其中一个主要原因就是人们没有健康保险。

sentences.en: And I think one of the things that I think many of us in the field are excited about
sentences.zh: 而且我认为领域内的许多人感到兴奋的一点是，

sentences.en: is that the ACA, for the first time, is going to make sure that millions of people in this country have access to health care.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》有史以来第一次确保了这个国家的数百万人都能够获得医疗保健。

sentences.en: That, in turn, allows them to then have access to mental health care.
sentences.zh: 这反过来又使他们能够获得心理健康护理。

sentences.en: So I think it's going to play a big role in us getting to literally millions of people who currently need our services but are not accessing them.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为它将在我们真正触及目前需要我们的服务却无法获得的数百万人的过程中发挥巨大作用。

sentences.en: I'm interested in hearing more about a program you support called Mental Health First Aid.
sentences.zh: 我有兴趣了解更多关于您支持的一个名为“心理健康急救”的项目。

sentences.en: Can you tell us about this program, why you think it's important to implement something like that now?
sentences.zh: 您能给我们介绍一下这个项目吗？为什么您认为现在落实这样一件事很重要？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Mental Health First Aid is a one-day training course that really helps the general public
sentences.zh: “心理健康急救”是一个为期一天的培训课程，它真正帮助普通公众

sentences.en: understand mental illness, understand or recognize when someone might be having a mental health problem,
sentences.zh: 理解精神疾病，理解或识别某人何时可能出现心理健康问题，

sentences.en: and know how to support the person and or refer the person for other help or to seek self-help.
sentences.zh: 并且知道如何支持这个人，和/或将这个人转介给其他帮助或寻求自助。

sentences.en: We are tremendously excited about it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: The response that we've gotten to our efforts to train people within the city has been really overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 我们为培训市内人员所做出的努力所收到的反响确实反响热烈。

sentences.en: Our goal right now is to train 10,000 people by the end of next year.
sentences.zh: 我们目前的宏伟目标是在明年年底前培训1,0000人。

sentences.en: And, you know, what's exciting about that is you think about even a large city like Philadelphia,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，令人兴奋的是，你想想即使像费城这样的大城市，

sentences.en: to have 10,000 people in our community that are better able to recognize when a person is having a mental health challenge, know how to respond, is very exciting.
sentences.zh: 在我们的社区里有1,0000人能够更好地识别一个人何时面临心理健康挑战，并知道如何应对，这是非常令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: You know, if you're in a restaurant and someone has a heart attack, there will probably be five or six people who can jump up and do CPR.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你在餐厅里，有人心脏病发作，可能会有五六个人挺身而出做心肺复苏。

sentences.en: If you're in a restaurant and someone starts to exhibit psychiatric symptoms, most people run the other way.
sentences.zh: 如果你在餐厅里，有人开始表现出精神病症状，大多数人会往反方向跑。

sentences.en: And so what Mental Health First Aid does is it really gives, you know, the average person the ability or the skills and the confidence to help people in those instances.
sentences.zh: 因此，“心理健康急救”所做的是，它确实赋予了普通人帮助这些情况下的能力、技能和信心。

sentences.en: And so it's been very well received by a broad cross-section of people in our city,
sentences.zh: 所以它受到了我们城市各阶层人们的广泛欢迎，

sentences.en: from people in our criminal justice system to people in our schools to people in corporate America.
sentences.zh: 从我们刑事司法系统的人到学校里的人，再到美国企业界的人。

sentences.en: People, regardless of where they are, recognize that these are issues that affect lots of people and that they need help in addressing those issues.
sentences.zh: 人们无论身处何地，都认识到这些是影响许多人的问题，他们需要帮助来解决这些问题。

sentences.en: If you know someone who you think has a mental disorder or if you're concerned about your own mental health,
sentences.zh: 如果你认识某人你认为他患有精神障碍，或者如果你担心你自己的心理健康，

sentences.en: you know, what are the first steps a person should take to find the right diagnosis and treatment?
sentences.zh: 你知道，一个人为了找到正确的诊断和治疗，应该采取的第一步是什么？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I think that varies a lot depending on what community you're in.
sentences.zh: 我认为这根据你所在的社区有很大不同。

sentences.en: If you're in Philadelphia, for example, we have a number of hotlines and numbers that you can call.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你在费城，我们有很多热线和电话号码可以拨打。

sentences.en: There's a suicide hotline.
sentences.zh: 有一个自杀热线。

sentences.en: We have a hotline for people who are in a psychiatric crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们为处于精神危机中的人们设立了热线。

sentences.en: We have information lines.
sentences.zh: 我们有信息热线。

sentences.en: For example, we have a website that we created that is called HealthyMindsPhilly.com.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们建立了一个名为HealthyMindsPhilly.com的网站。

sentences.en: And we created that website because we wanted to have a place that people could go on the website that was very accessible, that was destigmatized in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 我们创建这个网站是因为我们想要一个人们可以访问的地方，这个地方非常平易近人，而且在很多方面去除了污名化。

sentences.en: It's, you know, very colorful and accessible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它色彩丰富且容易访问。

sentences.en: And we put a lot of information out there, mental health screening, information about mental health first aid, information about how you access services.
sentences.zh: 我们在上面发布了大量信息，包括心理健康筛查、关于心理健康急救的信息、关于如何获取服务的信息。

sentences.en: And those kinds of resources, I think, help people to reach out for help.
sentences.zh: 我认为这类资源有助于人们寻求帮助。

sentences.en: If you're in a community, most communities do have a suicide hotline.
sentences.zh: 如果你在一个社区里，大多数社区确实都有自杀热线。

sentences.en: Most communities do have an information line.
sentences.zh: 大多数社区确实都有信息热线。

sentences.en: There's a national website called Network of Care, which is in many cities and states around the country.
sentences.zh: 有一个名为“关怀网络”的国家级网站，它遍布全国许多城市和州。

sentences.en: And that is a way.
sentences.zh: 这是一种途径。

sentences.en: So if you Google Network of Care in your town or your state, in many states you will find a website that will give you information on services in your community.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在你的城镇或州谷歌搜索“关怀网络”，在许多州你会找到一个网站，它会为你提供有关你社区中服务的信息。

sentences.en: So I would say, you know, unfortunately, unlike physical health care where people know where the local hospital is
sentences.zh: 所以我想说，不幸的是，与人们知道当地医院在哪里的身体健康护理不同，

sentences.en: and often have a relationship with a primary care provider, when it comes to mental health, people typically don't have those kinds of ongoing relationships.
sentences.zh: 并且通常与初级保健提供者有联系，当谈到心理健康时，人们通常没有那种长期的关系。

sentences.en: And so it takes a little bit of digging depending on what neighborhood or what community you're in.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据你所在的街区或社区，这需要一点挖掘。

sentences.en: Okay, Dr. Evans, thank you so much for joining us.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃文斯博士，非常感谢您加入我们。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate it, and I've had a great time.
sentences.zh: 我很感激，我度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: For more information on Dr. Evans' initiatives, please go to our website, speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 有关埃文斯博士各项举措的更多信息，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 伴随着美国心理学协会的《心理学话语》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
